title: Adjacent same-head written-tail triples carry a total-first additive relation
summary: A provisional1–4 interpretation of the four written tails may obey total = part1 + part2 in immediate same-head three-group constructions, beyond weak descending grade and value frequencies. GDT880 capacity failed; no arithmetic score was run.

design.mechanism: Total-first numerical relation in three immediately adjacent raw groups sharing one exact head
design.unit: Same-locus literal raw H-an/H-ain/H-aiin/H-aiiin windows with definite internal spaces; unique exact triple concordance across readings
design.contrast: Fixed run+1 total-first addition versus a nonarithmetic grade-order model allowing the same marginal values and weak descending order
design.prediction: Additive constraints should carry evidence beyond ordering and marginal frequencies; occasional equalities or repeatedgroups alone are insufficient
design.falsifier: An adequately informative predeclared comparison does not distinguish the additive law from the order/frequency rival
design.principal_risk: No source unit is independently established as an equation; provisional numbers remain unconfirmed and the current immediate-triple capacity is insufficient
design.selection_status: Original exploratory semantic hypothesis recorded after its preregistered capacity screen; not a new result or a selected arithmetic test
design.reopen_condition: Adequate new immediate-triple source capacity plus a predeclared genuinely discriminating order/frequency-aware design; no automatic wider window, head merger or offset change
